house:119:2:57.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended
house:119:2:57.reason:
The independent Immigration relationship is a proposed programme-eligibility overlap: section401 changes the income test for HUD-VASH/Section8 households, section404 creates a capped escrow mechanism for families already receiving USHA section8/9 assistance, and204 expands USDA504 repair LOAN eligibility to eligible low-income applicants. The complete dated42US1436a operative source expressly covers financial assistance under the UnitedStatesHousingAct1937 and USDA504; it restricts assistance to an alien unless resident in the UnitedStates AND within one of its seven printed status routes. These are existing programme-specific status conditions, not a new citizenship, admission, removal or work-authorisation rule enacted by this House vote. No relationship is inferred merely from HUD, rural housing, a veteran label or possible immigrant beneficiaries. HOME TitleII is not the Cranston TitleIII SubtitleA programme named in1436a(b1), and this candidate does not transplant the listed status categories to all HOME,FHA,CDBG,banking or future HUD programmes.

The dated1436a(a) alternatives retain permanent residence with the printed visitor/tourist/diplomat/student exclusions; the registry/residence/naturalisation-qualified branch; refugee or unrevoked asylum; specified parole; withholding; temporary/permanent1255a legalisation; and lawful Compact residency for the specified Compact period,with the separately stated Guam citizen/national preference. Mixed-family proration retains the exact b2 eligibility/non-establishment predicates; c retains pre-February5,1988 preservation/temporary-deferral rules and the separate bona-fide-student/family exception. Declarations,under62noncitizen documentation,verification,notice/opportunity/hearing protections and the PHA i2 election NOT to affirmatively establish eligibility before assistance remain distinct. The source's INS names,registry date alternatives and literal wording are not silently modernised. This source trace is not an individual legal-status or eligibility determination,an exhaustive current-law consolidation,or proof that all noncitizens are eligible or ineligible.

401(a) excludes qualifying chapter11/15 disability income for HUD-VASH and HUD-VASH-household eligibility for other assistance but expressly not adjusted income. The full August2024HUDnotice already excludes service-connected disability income for HUD-VASH eligibility while retaining separate tenant-payment treatment; it qualifies normal HCV/PBV requirements with specified referral,admission,documentation,income/asset,case-management,portability and project waivers. The VA determines veteran programme participation,PHAs ordinarily accept referrals with the printed lifetime-sex-offender exception,and case management applies as VA determines. The notice does not establish that every veteran receives housing. Its zero-HAP PBV option is restricted to stated VA-site/supportive-service projects and retains full-rent/utility responsibility until a HAP arises; it is not universal rent relief. 401(b)'s separately bounded future HUD programme/new VA-property dwelling clause does not receive an invented1436a coverage determination merely from the Secretary's name.

404requires existing8/9assistance,pilot enrollment and adjusted income≤80percentAMI at enrollment,with≤25eligibleentities/5000families. Its imported23(c2)entities include PHAs and qualifying project-based property owners/sponsors in accordance with23(l): voluntary availability/cooperation,project-based-resident/escrow duties,the1437f(o13)property exception and possible insufficient-funding suspension remain material. This does not import the existing FSS participation contract into the new pilot,which prohibits making a participation contract or individual training/services plan a condition. Withdrawal requires ceasing the incorporated CASH welfare assistance AND a printed timing/early-goal/good-cause branch; the cash definition excludes listed healthcare,nutrition,SSI/SSDI/SocialSecurity and noncash support. Five-to-seven-year account timing and seven-year programme termination are separate. Annual recertification,notice,opt-out without housing delay/denial/termination,no simultaneous FSS,and income/resource disregard for OTHER HUD programmes only remain. No universal escrow entitlement,all-benefit cessation,forfeiture rule or immigration-status waiver is inferred.

204leaves504grants within the existing very-low-income scope while adding loans for eligible low-income applicants. Its7500to15000change concerns the promissory-note security threshold,not a doubled grant maximum. The90day processing statement is sense-of-Congress with required reporting,not guaranteed approval. Programme/property/income and status predicates are cumulative; no individual recipient,loan approval or current-consolidated-law certificate follows. All earlier shared whole-package context,printed cross-reference uncertainties and governed source qualifications remain. Yea/Nay concern the entire February9suspension-and-passage package,not a separately inferred choice on disability income,escrow,noncitizen families,HOME or any banking component. No enactment,implementation,motive or predicted housing outcome is inferred.

house:119:2:176.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree
house:119:2:176.reason:
This is an independent proposed programme-eligibility overlap for the entire May20direct-concurrence replacement.602revises qualifying VA-disability income in HUD-VASH/USHA housing eligibility;404adds an escrow programme withinUSHA23;502(g)adds USDA504repair loans for eligible low-income applicants. Dated1436a expressly identifies USHA financial assistance and USDA504,with the source-specific residence,status,mixed-family and verification predicates. The vote does not enact a new citizenship/admission/removal rule,waive those predicates for every programme,or establish an individual's eligibility. No Immigration relationship is inherited from Health labels or general housing affordability rhetoric. HOME TitleII,guaranteed502loans,CDBG,new whole-home repairs and every HUD-administered future activity do not automatically receive1436a's named classifications.

The dated1436a(a) alternatives retain permanent residence with the printed visitor/tourist/diplomat/student exclusions; the registry/residence/naturalisation-qualified branch; refugee or unrevoked asylum; specified parole; withholding; temporary/permanent1255a legalisation; and lawful Compact residency for the specified Compact period,with the separately stated Guam citizen/national preference. Mixed-family proration retains the exact b2 eligibility/non-establishment predicates; c retains pre-February5,1988 preservation/temporary-deferral rules and the separate bona-fide-student/family exception. Declarations,under62noncitizen documentation,verification,notice/opportunity/hearing protections and the PHA i2 election NOT to affirmatively establish eligibility before assistance remain distinct. The source's INS names,registry date alternatives and literal wording are not silently modernised. This source trace is not an individual legal-status or eligibility determination,an exhaustive current-law consolidation,or proof that all noncitizens are eligible or ineligible.

For precision,404defines a covered family by receiving8/9assistance AND enrollment; its separate3(B)bars ESCROWING AMOUNTS for a family whose adjusted income exceeds80percentAMI at enrollment. This is not an invented blanket definition of family admission eligibility. The Secretary MAY establish the pilot,with≤25eligibleentities/5000families,subject to its actual funds-use/appropriation conditions. The imported23(c2)/(l)project-owner/cooperation/escrow exceptions remain qualified,and11permits waiving requirements UNDER THIS SECTION23; it is not an automatic waiver of every other statute,1436a or programme. Recertification may occur multiple times at family request,as the Secretary determines,and not less than yearly UNLESS an approved alternative rent structure applies. This qualification retains the printed exception to earlier shared shorthand about annual recertification.

Withdrawals retain ceasing narrowly defined cash-welfare assistance AND the printed ordinary5–7yearaccount/early-exit/approved-goal/good-cause or984.303(k)reason. Complete incorporated303(e)/(k)and305(a2iii)/(c)trace good-faith replacement of unavailable services,reassessment of whether equivalent services achieve the purpose,integral-service determination,permanent-disability/new-head alternative,qualified portability and disbursement net of amounts due under the assisted lease with income-correction rules. The new pilot does not require a standard participation contract or individual training/services plan; the references to oldCoP circumstances are not silently turned into a new contract or universal forfeiture mandate. At-least5yearaccount maintenance retains its listed termination/assistance-exit exceptions and family7yearoption. TENyearprogramme termination is not the Februarysevenyearsunset or a tenyearaccount. Opt-out and participation/nonparticipation cannot delay,deny or terminate housing assistance; simultaneous ordinaryFSS is barred. Earnings disregards cover otherHUDprogrammes during enrollment,not every Federal benefit.

602retains income eligibility versus adjusted-income/rent distinctions,chapters11/15and actualHUD-VASH-household scope. Existing2024HUDservice-connected-income policy/referral,asset,case-management,PBVzero-HAP and qualified waiver rules remain; this is not all access first created by the bill. UnlikeFebruary401(b),602(b)does NOT require a HUDprogramme not yet in existence: it concerns a dwelling constructed on VA Department property on/after enactment,assisted through a HUDprogramme. No blanket1436acoverage for that separately worded clause,all veterans,all housing or every rent is certified.

502(g)expands LOANincome eligibility while504grants retain their existing very-low-income scope;7500to15000is the promissory-note threshold,not a doubled grantmaximum. Complete dated521(a2)/(d)and542sources qualify rural assistance/renewal/decoupling and voucher calculations: project/owner/feasibility/rent/use restrictions and annual appropriations remain,as do the printed low-income/lease/residence criteria and recalculation/recertification rules. The1436a list specifically names521(a2)(A); it does not turn every514/515/516project,guaranteed502loan or542voucher into a newly certified status category. Guaranteed-loan childcare/business-use and transfer/assumption exceptions retain other eligibility/loan/property requirements. Whole-home-repair alternate Medicaid/CHIP/SSI/SNAP/TANF criteria are INCOME criteria,not full benefit receipt/status eligibility or a new determination for those programmes. Existing HOME/tenant-selection/expired-authorisation and rural-definition citation uncertainties remain literal,with no repair or autonomous revival. ESGcap waivers and MTWwork-requirement STUDY are not universal services or a new nationwide work mandate.200millioninnovationauthorisation versus1202noadditional-funds tension remains unresolved rather than converted into an actual appropriation.

Yea/Nay concern this whole12title Mayreplacement; NotVoting is resolved nondirectional,not opposition or an explanation for absence. Its operative H.Res1299concurrence is not classified as mere permission to debate. No component preference,motive,enactment,agency implementation,current-consolidated-law or individual status/benefit certificate follows.
